summary: Launch/render check, re-verified at 20:10. 5 boxes PASS_SP (.110 .123 .143 .184 .240), showing the full 3D 'Select game profile' screen fullscreen. .133 and .171 FAIL: in repeated frames the profile panel stays half-drawn with no '< create new >' text, so the round agent's 'mid-animation' reading was wrong. .124 BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd). .186 and .243 NA. Multiplayer is peer DirectPlay with no server and needs a person (profile creation plus the host lobby), so players_in_one_game=0. The game was closed on all 7 boxes; WM_CLOSE was ignored, so it was force-killed, and none remain.
issues: .133 and .171: the H&D profile panel never fully draws (no top/left border, no menu text) in 3 frames over ~1 min. .133 already looked like this on 2026-08-31; .171 is a regression (full panel on 2026-08-31, before its GPU changed). Needs a check at the physical screen to rule out a GDI capture artefact.

HDE.exe ignores WM_CLOSE at the profile screen; lanparty force-killed it after 12 s on all 7 boxes. Post-kill: no hde.exe/dwwin left, every box at its normal desktop mode (none stranded at 640x480), foreground is the agent or chat console.
Multiplayer cannot be automated: there is no staged Savegame profile, and the host lobby (campaign/mission/soldiers) has no command-line route. The attended plan is two 4-player sessions.
The lanparty.py 'kill' action takes the game as a positional argument; the task text's '--game' flag is rejected.
library_fix_needed: Stage a default game profile (Savegame\*.bin) so launches skip 'Select game profile' - needed before attended or automated MP.
